decisions.reason: The tax-inclusive order total and pretax item revenue are linked monetary measures at order and item grains, but the pinned public seeds show a 3,398,137-cent difference due to tax; an unqualified cross-grain-equivalent label is contradicted by the sample.

Food and drink revenue sum the same product_price input at the same item grain, with different category predicates. The taxonomy treats disjoint sibling slices as scope variants; they are not interchangeable.

Customer and order counts are different non-substitutable measures, but their entities are linked by the repository's customer-to-order relationship and orders-per-customer derivation. This taxonomy labels such measures related.

All-time order totals reconcile with summed customer lifetime spend in the pinned seeds, but the default metric time dimensions ordered_at and first_ordered_at assign values to different dates on every one of the 365 sample dates. The label reflects a time-rule variant; an all-time cross-grain relationship would require explicit time alignment and verified one-customer-per-order mapping.
